pois.title: Albino American Alligator
pois.guide: Rare white alligator that turns up now and then in the swamps. Dangerous; shoot from range.

pois.title: American Alligator
pois.guide: Big swamp predator that hides well; keep your distance.

pois.title: American Crocodile
pois.guide: Leonida's biggest reptile, at home in salt water along the coast.

pois.title: American Red Fox
pois.guide: Bigger than a gray fox, with a white tail tip. Lives in the northern forests.

pois.title: Black Fox
pois.guide: Rare black-furred fox, seen in several parts of Leonida. A light rifle keeps the pelt clean.

pois.title: Box Turtle
pois.guide: Small turtle that shuts itself inside its shell; easiest to find in the swamps.

pois.title: Canada Goose
pois.guide: Black head, white cheeks. Common on fresh water and in town parks, and it will charge you.

pois.title: Cane Toad
pois.guide: Huge toad that lives mostly in the swamps. A heavy gun spoils the pelt.

pois.title: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
pois.guide: Listen for the rattle in the forests. Its bite can kill, so take care.

pois.title: Eastern Gray Squirrel
pois.guide: Common everywhere, usually busy with nuts and seeds. An easy shot with a light rifle.

pois.title: Golden Fox
pois.guide: Rare golden-furred red fox from the northern forests. Go gentle to keep the pelt.

pois.title: Green Iguana
pois.guide: Invasive lizard all over the warm south, towns included, usually near water.

pois.title: Leonida Cottonmouth
pois.guide: Venomous swamp snake with dark bands around a thick body.

pois.title: Leonida Kingsnake
pois.guide: Mid-sized brown constrictor with yellow bands, in forests and grassland. A heavy gun ruins it.

pois.title: Leonida Wild Turkey
pois.guide: Big turkey of the forests and grassy lowlands. Go gentle to keep the carcass.

pois.title: Leonida Wild White Tom
pois.guide: Rare white-feathered wild turkey, in forests and grassy lowlands.

pois.title: Marsh Rabbit
pois.guide: Shy little rabbit of the swamps and southern coast; a light rifle does it.

pois.title: Mottled Duck
pois.guide: Freshwater duck with a glossy blue patch on each wing.

pois.title: North American River Otter
pois.guide: Dark brown otter of the swamps, sometimes along rivers.

pois.title: Northern Black Coyote
pois.guide: Rare black-furred coyote of the forests and swamps. Keep your distance.

pois.title: Northern Coyote
pois.guide: Red-gray coyote with big ears that hunts in packs through forests and swamps. Best taken at long range.

pois.title: Northern Raccoon
pois.guide: Out at night, raiding bins in town as happily as it lives in forests and swamps.

pois.title: Nutria
pois.guide: Invasive water rodent that looks like an oversized rat, found in the swamps. A heavy gun ruins it.

pois.title: Round-Tailed Muskrat
pois.guide: Small water rodent with a compact body and a long scaly tail, near swamps and fresh water.

pois.title: Softshell Turtle
pois.guide: Swamp turtle with a long snorkel nose; a light rifle is enough.

pois.title: Spectacled Caiman
pois.guide: Smaller cousin of the alligator, just as tough.

pois.title: Whitetail Deer
pois.guide: Grazes in woods, swamps and grassy lowlands. Spooks easily, so shoot from far off.

pois.title: Wild Boar
pois.guide: Aggressive forager of woods and swamps, out mostly at night.

pois.title: Atlantic Spadefish
pois.guide: Round, striped fish found along most of the coast.

pois.title: Atlantic Spanish Mackerel
pois.guide: Slim silver fish with yellow spots, all along the coast.

pois.title: Atlantic Tarpon
pois.guide: Big silver-green fish, in shallow and deep sea alike.

pois.title: Bluestriped Grunt
pois.guide: Yellow fish with bright blue stripes, in the warm southern waters.

pois.title: Cobia
pois.guide: Brown-banded fish of the deep sea around Leonida.

pois.title: Common Snook
pois.guide: Has a thin black stripe along its side; off the east coast.

pois.title: Great Barracuda
pois.guide: Toothy silver-blue hunter off the south coast and in deeper water.

pois.title: Green Moray Eel
pois.guide: Green eel living in the coastal coral reefs.

pois.title: Hogfish
pois.guide: Pink fish with a pig-like snout, in warm coastal water.

pois.title: Littlehead Porgy
pois.guide: Tall flat face with blue stripes. In coastal water to the south and west.

pois.title: Mahi-Mahi
pois.guide: Blue-green with a bulging head; reefs and deeper water.

pois.title: Northern Red Snapper
pois.guide: Bright red, thick-bodied fish, most common in the warmer south.

pois.title: Red Lionfish
pois.guide: Invasive, with venomous striped spines. In coastal water to the south.

pois.title: Spotted Moray Eel
pois.guide: Spotted eel hiding in the coastal reefs.

pois.title: Stoplight Parrotfish
pois.guide: Colourful fish with a yellow spot near its gills.

pois.title: Tiger Grouper
pois.guide: Striped grouper found across the southern and western waters.

pois.title: Yellowtail Snapper
pois.guide: Yellow forked tail; southern coast and deeper western water.

pois.title: Alpine Goat
pois.guide: Horned, bearded farm goat that will charge if you get careless.

pois.title: Bottlenose Dolphin
pois.guide: Common in the sea all around Leonida; long snout.

pois.title: Brown Rat
pois.guide: Lives anywhere people do, and there are always more of them.

pois.title: Holstein Cattle
pois.guide: The black and white dairy cows on Leonida's farms.

pois.title: Short-Beaked Common Dolphin
pois.guide: Smaller dolphin off the coast with an hourglass pattern on its side.

pois.title: Balinese
pois.guide: Long-haired pet cat with blue eyes.

pois.title: Calico
pois.guide: Black, white and orange cat, at home indoors or out on the street.

pois.title: Ginger Longhair
pois.guide: Long-furred ginger cat, common in town and beyond.

pois.title: Ginger Tabby
pois.guide: The ginger street cat you see all over Leonida.

pois.title: Striped Tabby
pois.guide: Street and alley cat with the tabby's dark M on its forehead.

pois.title: American Pit Bull Terrier
pois.guide: Stocky, powerful dog with a smooth head, kept as a pet or a guard dog.

pois.title: Doberman Pinscher
pois.guide: Sleek, athletic guard dog; like a Rottweiler but leaner.

pois.title: German Shepherd
pois.guide: Fast, strong and clever; the police and guard dog with the thick coat.

pois.title: Green Sea Turtle
pois.guide: Biggest hard-shelled turtle, around reefs and the coast.

pois.title: American Crow
pois.guide: Clever black bird on trees and rooftops everywhere.

pois.title: American Robin
pois.guide: Small songbird with a red breast and dark head, in town and country.

pois.title: American White Ibis
pois.guide: White wading bird with a curved orange beak, on fresh water near the coast and in the swamps.

pois.title: American White Pelican
pois.guide: The bigger of the two pelicans; swamps, rivers and coast.

pois.title: Bald Eagle
pois.guide: White-headed bird of prey, seen hunting small animals across Leonida.

pois.title: Black Vulture
pois.guide: Black carrion bird with a gray-black head, turning up in several regions.

pois.title: Blue Jay
pois.guide: Bright blue with a crest, flocking in the forests and sometimes in town.

pois.title: Caspian Tern
pois.guide: Large tern with a black cap and orange bill, all round the coast.

pois.title: Common Loon
pois.guide: Black and white water bird with red eyes; great in water and air, hopeless on land.

pois.title: Double-Crested Cormorant
pois.guide: Black water bird with a hooked bill and orange face.

pois.title: Eastern Brown Pelican
pois.guide: Coastal pelican, in towns too, that dives for fish.

pois.title: Glossy Ibis
pois.guide: Dark wading bird with a sickle-shaped bill, in swamps and along the coast.

pois.title: Great Blue Heron
pois.guide: Tall blue-grey wading bird of swamps and coast.

pois.title: Great Egret
pois.guide: Tall white wading bird with a long pointed bill, mostly in swamps.

pois.title: House Sparrow
pois.guide: Tiny gray-brown bird found everywhere, mostly in towns.

pois.title: Laughing Gull
pois.guide: Gull with a black head and a cackling call, on the coast.

pois.title: Leghorn Chicken
pois.guide: The everyday farm hen.

pois.title: Monk Parakeet
pois.guide: Small green parrot; look in the southern towns.

pois.title: New World Oriole
pois.guide: Small orange songbird with white wing bars, mostly in forests.

pois.title: Red-Bellied Woodpecker
pois.guide: Easier to spot by the red on its crown than its belly. Pecking trees all over Leonida.

pois.title: Red-Cockaded Woodpecker
pois.guide: Black-capped woodpecker with a small red flash on the side of its head, nesting in big trees.

pois.title: Red-Crowned Parrot
pois.guide: Green parrot with a red forehead, a rare one.

pois.title: Red-Tailed Hawk
pois.guide: Big hawk with a red tail, mostly over forests.

pois.title: Roseate Spoonbill
pois.guide: Pink wading bird with a flat, spoon-shaped bill.

pois.title: Tricolored Heron
pois.guide: Smaller blue, gray and white heron of the swamps.

pois.title: Turkey Vulture
pois.guide: Brown scavenger with a bare red head.

pois.title: Whooping Crane
pois.guide: Tall white crane with black wingtips and a red forehead.

pois.title: Wood Stork
pois.guide: Bald-headed wading bird of the northern coast and swamps.

pois.title: Atlantic Goliath Grouper
pois.guide: Huge mottled brown fish of warm reefs.

pois.title: Great Hammerhead Shark
pois.guide: The biggest hammerhead, in the seas around Leonida. Mostly ignores people.

pois.title: Moon Jellyfish
pois.guide: See-through jellyfish, usually in deeper water.

pois.title: Portuguese Man o' War
pois.guide: Floats on the surface from the southeast round to the northwest. The sting can kill; steer clear.

pois.title: Spotted Eagle Ray
pois.guide: Ray with white spots and a long tail, along the coast.

pois.title: Tiger Shark
pois.guide: Huge striped shark that hunts at night, in all of Leonida's seas.

pois.title: Albino Spectacled Caiman
pois.guide: Rare albino caiman in the wetlands. A low-power rifle keeps it in one piece.

pois.title: Unique Swamp Alligator
pois.guide: One of Leonida's 8 unique animals. Look in Buckskin Swamp in Kelly County; follow the map pin.
pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.title: Unique Black Bear
pois.guide: One of Leonida's 8 unique animals. Look just south of Hamlet; follow the map pin.
pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.title: Unique Panther
pois.guide: One of Leonida's 8 unique animals. Look on Belpoint, near the long west-facing beach; follow the map pin.
pois.revealedGuide: Counts towards the Legendary Hunter challenge, which needs all 8 unique animals. Hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel also pops the Fair Game trophy; which one isn't confirmed yet.

pois.title: Blue Axanthic Iguana
pois.guide: Rare iguana with no red or yellow in its scales, so it shows electric blue. Likes the warm south, towns included, near fresh water; a low-power rifle keeps it in one piece.

pois.title: Mosaic Mottled Duck
pois.guide: Rare coloured version of the mottled duck, now and then on fresh water around Leonida. A gentle weapon keeps the carcass good.

pois.title: Soot-Spotted Cottontail Rabbit
pois.guide: Rare black-and-white cottontail, seen now and then in several parts of Leonida. Use a low-power rifle or the carcass is ruined.

pois.title: Spotted Wild Boar
pois.guide: Rare spotted wild boar, now and then in forests and wetlands. Take it on from long range.

pois.title: Super Red Iguana
pois.guide: Rare red-scaled iguana in the warm south, towns included, near fresh water. A low-power rifle keeps it in one piece.

pois.title: More hunting animals
pois.guide: Count the animals you've studied in the game's Hunting group that don't have their own row here yet. All of them now have their own row, so this counter is retired. If you counted one here, take it off this counter and tick its row instead.

pois.guide: Best spot: the Atlantic north-east of Vice Beach, Vice-Dale County. Use a large saltwater lure.

pois.title: Bluegill
pois.guide: Best spot: the Nehrling River in North Mariana County. Use a small freshwater lure.

pois.title: Candy Fish
pois.guide: Best spot: Lake Leonida. Use a candy Cane lure.

pois.title: Channel Catfish
pois.guide: Best spot: Buckskin Swamp in South Kelly County. Use a medium freshwater lure.

pois.title: Greater Amberjack
pois.guide: Best spot: the Atlantic off the south-east coast of Dalton Island, Vice-Dale County. Use a small saltwater lure.

pois.title: Rock Sea Bass
pois.guide: Best spot: the water west of Watson Bay, Mariana County. Use a small saltwater lure.

pois.title: Striped Bass
pois.guide: Best spot: Patridge Bay in northern Lummox County. Use a medium saltwater lure.

pois.title: Black Drum
pois.guide: Best spot: Okchiloha Bay in north-west Lummox County.

pois.title: Leonida Gar
pois.guide: Best spot: the Grassrivers west of Hamlet, Mariana County. Use a medium freshwater lure.

pois.title: Redfin Pickerel
pois.guide: Best spot: south-west of Buckskin Swamp in South Kelly County. Use a small freshwater lure.

pois.title: Salt Fish
pois.guide: Best spot: Lake Leonida, in the south of North Leonard County. Use a medium freshwater lure.

pois.title: Yellowfin Tuna
pois.guide: Best spot: the Gulf of Leonida west of Tola Bay, Mariana County. Use a large saltwater lure.

pois.title: More fish

pois.title: Humpback Whale
pois.guide: Big whale with long flippers and a bumpy head; breaches out in the deep ocean.

pois.title: Sperm Whale
pois.guide: Huge whale with a big square head, seen now and then in the deep ocean around Leonida.

pois.title: More mammals
pois.guide: Count the animals you've studied in the game's Mammals group that don't have their own row here yet. All of them now have their own row, so this counter is retired. If you counted one here, take it off this counter and tick its row instead.

pois.title: Russian Blue
pois.guide: Short-haired pedigree cat with a blue-grey coat; calm and clever.

pois.title: Bengal
pois.guide: Pet cat with leopard-print fur.

pois.title: Blotched Tabby
pois.guide: Common tabby, as a housecat or a stray, all over Leonida.

pois.title: Bullworth Longhair
pois.guide: Big cat with an unusually shaggy coat; a sought-after pet.

pois.title: Chocolate Longhair
pois.guide: Long-haired chocolate-brown cat, seen wherever there are people.

pois.title: Cream Longhair
pois.guide: Long-haired cream cat that prowls streets and alleys.

pois.title: Mackerel Tabby
pois.guide: Tabby with fishbone-striped fur, in most built-up areas.

pois.title: Persian
pois.guide: Thick-furred, laid-back luxury cat.

pois.title: Ragdoll
pois.guide: Large, silky cat, seen wherever there are people.

pois.title: Red Tabby
pois.guide: Friendly red-coated tabby, found across Leonida.

pois.title: More cats & dogs
pois.guide: Count the animals you've studied in the game's Cats & dogs group that don't have their own row here yet. All of them now have their own row, so this counter is retired. If you counted one here, take it off this counter and tick its row instead.

pois.title: Atlantic Bluefin Tuna
pois.guide: Massive tuna that roams the deep ocean around Leonida.

pois.title: Atlantic Sailfish
pois.guide: Big fish with a huge dorsal fin and needle snout, in the deep water east of Leonida.

pois.title: Bull Shark

pois.title: Truffade Andrew Node's Thrax
pois.guide: A supercar with no tracker, at the end of the trail the No Flusher tags start.
pois.revealedGuide: Scan 10 No Flusher tags with WAiNK and you're texted into the No Flushers' conspiracy chat, which leads to their hideout garage in Ocean Beach. The door code is 8554013 (it's on a note on the wall: flip it over). Inside, the map on the wall marks Andrew Node's house on the south-east side of Starfish Island, off Sabal Circle. Two guards are there, so arriving by boat is easiest. His Truffade Thrax is in the garage, with no tracker. Registering it at a Pay 'n' Spray costs $70,000. Once the trail is open, the remaining tags may not scan until it's finished.

pois.title: Imponte Soaring Phoenix
pois.guide: A one-off customised Phoenix: gold paint, firebird hood art, a supercharger through the bonnet and TORQ Wheels on the back window. Parked inside the open garage by the canal in Watson Bay (the same garage as the Elias Delgado - Silver card). Locked, but no security or tracker. Worth $3,250 to sell, $11,900 to register.

pois.title: Bravado Driveshaft Gauntlet
pois.guide: A one-off Gauntlet in Driveshaft livery, parked at this spot in Grayson.

pois.title: Nagasaki Azalea Street Blazer
pois.guide: A one-off Street Blazer quad bike with its own custom livery. Parked on the grass by the fire pit and picnic table outside the red building by the marsh, east Watson Bay (right next to the Danny McLean - Standard card). Locked, but no security or tracker. Worth $1,300 to sell, $4,650 to register.

pois.title: Bravado King of Swing Youga
pois.guide: A one-off Youga van covered in bright psychedelic flowers. Parked by the road just west of the river bridge, near the cul-de-sac with the heart-shaped pond. Locked, but no security or tracker. Worth $1,450 to sell, $5,400 to register.

pois.title: Bravado Banshee
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. There's always one in the middle of the three hexagonal showrooms in the north-east of Southside, Vice City. Taking it also earns Capital Offense. Randy pays about $3,150.

pois.title: Granforma Zorrusso
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. You pick it up during a chapter 3 story mission, from a walled ground-floor garage at an apartment block in Ocean Beach.

pois.title: Piccia Furia
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. One is always parked in the driveway of the second house north of the main road on Vespucci Island, in the Rialto Islands, next to a Buckingham Jubilee. Randy pays about $20,200.

pois.title: Pegassi Vitello
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. It's at a gated villa on Flamingo Pkwy in Waning Sands, Leonard County. Climb the fence; it's in the garage closest to the house.

pois.title: Pegassi '96 Infernus
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. It's on an upper level of the multi-storey garage at Crosstown Police Station on NW 9th St, Vice City. Slip in when a cop opens the gate, or use code 5270 on the stairwell door on the south side and climb to the 7th floor; the roof's stunt jump is a quick way out.

pois.title: Pegassi Tempesta
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Around midday it's being towed on NE 3rd St in Vice City while the owner argues with the tow driver; take it off the tow truck.

pois.title: Ascot Paragon
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. One is always in the south corner of the car dealership west of Dynamix Fitness in Bayside, Vice City: drive it out through the east wall. Randy pays about $14,755.

pois.title: Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Parked at the back of the gang-run Nova Auto junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St in Hamlet. Open the entrance gates, then keep low along the right-hand side to take it without a fight.

pois.title: Grotti Itali RSX
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. It's kept in a villa garage on Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands, between Vice City and Vice Beach. Climb the wooden fence, open the garage and use the key cloner.

pois.title: Ubermacht Cypher
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. No fixed spot. It's most often in Ocean Beach, Vice Beach: try outside Cirque de Cuisine off Fig St and along Shore Dr. Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to check.

pois.title: Pegassi Toros
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Parked outside the Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr, Tequesta Retreat, from about 6:30 PM, with guards nearby. It also turns up at the rich houses in Capri.

pois.title: Pfister Growler
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Try the multi-storey car park on Fig St in Ocean Beach around 5 PM. Otherwise look along the Shore Dr beachfront or around the rich houses of northern Capri, and scan with WAiNK.

pois.title: Buckingham Windsor Drop
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. No fixed spot. It's usually parked outside the villas in the rich part of Capri; also seen at the Status Auto Imports showroom in Bayside. Save and reload if it's not there.

pois.title: Grotti Carbonizzare
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. No fixed spot. Check the public car parks of northern Capri and scan cars with WAiNK.

pois.title: Gallivanter Baller ST-D
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Look outside the wealthy houses in northern Capri, where it's often parked. It isn't always there, so scan high-end cars with WAiNK to check.

pois.title: Ocelot Jugular
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Often parked at the kerb outside the BITE store on Atlantic Ave, just north of Ocean Beach near Easy Electronics. Randy also takes the Bloodless Jugular from a garage off Chastity Ave in north Belville.

pois.title: Benefactor Dubsta
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Try the mansions on Starfish Island, reached by road from Waxman Island: the waterfront house at the north-east end often has one in its garage. It isn't always there, so scan high-end cars with WAiNK to check.

pois.title: Pfister Neon
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Look outside the wealthy houses in northern Capri, where it's often parked. It isn't always there, so scan high-end cars with WAiNK to check.

pois.title: Buckingham Jubilee
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. It has no fixed spot, but it's often parked at the rich houses of northern Capri, sometimes behind a gate you can climb past. Scan cars with WAiNK to check.

pois.title: '64 Mamba GT
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List. Randy adds it late on with the side job Dale Mamba!. It's behind the right-hand building of a guarded mansion in Leaf Links; the key is in a bowl behind the sofa in the main house. It has a tracker.

pois.title: Truffade Thrax
pois.guide: For Randy's Wish List: the last of the 22 cars, unlocked once the other 21 are delivered. Randy calls to say it's on Dalton Island: take the ferry over from Waxman Island and take it from the big car park behind the Dalton Island Club, then ferry it back and drop it at Bayside Drive Garage.

pois.title: BF '77 Bandito
pois.guide: Pays $3,350. The silver off-roader in a group driving around Buckskin Swamp. Talk to the driver so they stop and get out, then jump in. It's a one-seater, and the group chases you.

pois.title: Declasse Yosemite 1500
pois.guide: Pays $1,850. In the driveway of a house in the east of the search area in south-west Port Gellhorn, being towed away. Talking to the tow driver won't work: knock him out, then lower the truck off the hook from the back.

pois.title: Western Nightblade
pois.guide: Pays $6,310. The orange bike on the ground floor of the central garage at a gang operation site in Ambrosia, where enemies shoot on sight. For a quieter way in, climb the green container north of the fence and jump over.

pois.title: Karin '85 Futo
pois.guide: Pays $1,500. In a garage at the west end of the building on Draper Island's south edge; go in by the north door and open the garage door with the button beside it. Park before the security gates and hop the fences to stay quiet.

pois.title: Declasse '74 Vamos
pois.guide: Pays $4,200. In the shed east of a house north-east of Grayson, where armed locals hang out. The shed's side-door code, 2727, is on signs inside the main trailer; open the garage door with the button on the right to drive out.

pois.title: Annis '95 Hellion
pois.guide: Pays $1,400. In the driveway of the middle house in the south Port Gellhorn neighbourhood. Calm the barking dog in the yard, or just drive off.

pois.title: Declasse '64 Mamba GT
pois.guide: For Wyman's Classic Car Collection: the third car he rebuilds. Scan all four wrecked parts of this car with WAiNK: in the garage of a grey farmhouse on the east edge of Gellhorn, north of the state prison; sunk in the pond just east of the Thrillbilly Mud Club dirt track; behind a grey garage door on a green building in the alley beside the Xero station in Ambrosia; and in the water under the broken bridge in north Moreau, north of Buck Creek Country Store (you can scan it from the bridge). Wyman then charges $1,500 through BuckMe for the rebuild. Register it at a Pay 'n' Spray or park it in your garage to keep it.

pois.title: '67 Transgressor
pois.guide: For Wyman's Classic Car Collection: the first car he rebuilds. All three parts to scan with WAiNK are in Port Gellhorn: in a field with pigs at the Tanglewood Ln trailer park, north of Sarena's Bargain Store; in a garage behind a blue house with sunflower decorations on Gellhorn Ave, north-west of Wasteland Off-Road; and behind a wooden hut at the southern tip, below Dirt Merchants. Wyman then charges $1,500 for the rebuild.

pois.title: '70 Riata
pois.guide: For Wyman's Classic Car Collection: the second car he rebuilds. Scan all three parts with WAiNK: in a carport at the end of Cangrejo St in Southwind (just east of Mile Zero Air Station), west of the Xero station; under a house on Sunset Dr in Key Lento, a few houses south-west of the Christmas House and across from the police impound; and behind the abandoned gas station on Old Fort Rd in Shoreless Keys, north of Grassrivers Cafe & Deli. Wyman then charges $1,500 for the rebuild.

pois.title: Reynolds
pois.guide: For Wyman's Classic Car Collection: the fourth car he rebuilds. Ultimate Edition only. Scan all five parts with WAiNK: in a locked Scoop shipping container near the beach at Wild Hog Point (you need the lock-cutting tool from chapter 3); in the locked garage of a white house in the north-west of Capri, the one with two bins outside, opposite the construction site; behind Donnies Auto Repair in Watson Bay, down the gravel track beside it; behind the wooden gate of a house on the north of Casanova Island in the Rialto Islands, next to an empty plot; and inside Willie's Service Center on SW 7th Ave in Salton, just north of the 7th Avenue Garage (breaking in sets off the alarm). Wyman then charges $1,500 for the rebuild.

pois.title: '72 Deviant
pois.guide: For Wyman's Classic Car Collection: the fifth and last car. No parts to scan: after the Reynolds Kit Car, Wyman calls and asks for a $1,000 mechanic fee through BuckMe. Then collect it at his scrapyard on the edge of Capri (Map > Vehicles > Wyman's Auto Salvage). Register it at a Pay 'n' Spray or park it in a garage to keep it.

pois.revealedGuide: Del Rio Boulevard, southern La Perle: a small grey garage at the far end of the parking lot behind the buildings across the road from Twa Ponya Tattoo, with pink bow graffiti by the door and a keypad under it. The code is 92665. To get it, open Boobie's laptop in the bedroom of the Vice City apartment in chapter 3. The password is MuffinsQueen15: Muffins from the framed photo of Boobie's late dog, Queen from the drawing of the dog with a crown by the bed, and 15 from the back of that drawing. A message on the laptop gives the code. Inside is a free car, Vanessa's Growler. Doesn't count towards Little Boxes.

pois.title: Doubloons
pois.guide: Spanish cargo wreck east of Key Lento, beyond the island north-east of Kenton's shop; the Island Dreams wreck. Its 10 gold doubloons sit in 4 dig spots: a chest just north of the prow by scattered pottery; on the seabed under the coral a little north-east of the wreck (a second one lies nearby along the coral edge); at the base of the mushroom coral north of the wreck; and in the sand inside the opening into the hull. You can dig up the first three during Island Dreams; come back afterwards for the one in the hull. Use the metal detector and give them to Kenton.

pois.title: Easter egg 1
pois.guide: A night-time secret in Kelly County, linked to a hidden trophy.
pois.revealedGuide: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM and look for a car with flashing lights at the roadside. Follow the path into the woods towards a blue light, agree to help the woman the UFO drops off and walk her back to her car. The UFO then takes you and you wake up three days later. It earns The Truth Is Out There. The car doesn't always spawn: drive away and come back if it isn't there.

pois.title: Easter egg 2
pois.guide: A creature sighting on a road south of Hamlet.
pois.revealedGuide: Drive the road south of Hamlet and look for Bigfoot feeding on a deer on the road. Follow him on foot into the swamp to an effigy in green mist and stand in the mist until you black out; he comes to look at you and you wake up nearby. It works without Kirk's missions.

pois.title: Easter egg 3
pois.guide: A nod to another Rockstar game, from chapter 2, in Port Gellhorn.
pois.revealedGuide: At a yard sale outside a house with balloons in south Port Gellhorn, west of Buck's Pawn Shop, the Genuine Cowboy Hat sits on the sofa. Preview it and buy it for $35.

pois.title: Easter egg 4
pois.guide: A nod to an older GTA game, from chapter 3, in Vice City. It's tied to a hidden trophy.
pois.revealedGuide: A nod to GTA III: once you have the Key Cloner, steal the blue Banshee with the white stripe from the Sunrise Premium Autos showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it out through the front window. It earns Capital Offense.

pois.title: Easter egg 5
pois.guide: A chatty animal in Key Lento, from chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: After delivering Shirley's rum, go behind the Three Sheets liquor store in Key Lento, deal with the goons and talk to the parrot. It tips you off to cash hidden in a vent, with more loot nearby.

pois.title: Easter egg 6
pois.guide: A puzzle in a chapter 3 apartment that leads to a hidden garage.
pois.revealedGuide: In the chapter 3 apartment, the memorial photo, the notepad on the vanity and the back of that notepad give the laptop password: Muffins, Queen, 15, in that order. A message then sends you code 92665 for a garage with a bow drawn on it behind Auntie's Place in La Perle (reach it through the motel lot next to Aline's Thrift Store). Inside is Vanessa's pink Pfister Growler, and the Del Rio Blvd garage becomes yours free.

pois.title: Easter egg 7
pois.guide: A puzzle at an abandoned building deep in the swamp, open as soon as you can roam freely.
pois.revealedGuide: Take a boat to the abandoned research station with tall antennas in Pelican Valley, Gullet Marsh. Turn the power on at the breaker box out back, find the password CLEAVES carved into the bedroom floor and use it on the computer. Clues around the station give the safe code ($1,100 inside) and then the keypad code for a shack on the water, where the scientist's crab experiments ended badly. Inside are $10,000 in marked bills and the Crabshack VF5 SMG.

pois.title: Easter egg 8
pois.guide: A nod to a TV show at an apartment block in Vice Beach, open from the start of free roam.
pois.revealedGuide: Go to Trinity Apartments, a small light-blue block with a round stairwell on Washington Island, Vice Beach. Dexter Morgan's door is the corner flat at the west end of the second-floor walkway, facing the water (you can't go in). Climb to the roof for his kill kit, and steal the Lure Predator boat moored nearby, a stand-in for his Slice of Life.

pois.title: Easter egg 9
pois.guide: Something comes to the rescue if you're stranded at sea. Works at any point in the game.
pois.revealedGuide: Take a boat out into open water (Gambit Bay works), jump off and swim away from it for about five minutes. A dog on a jet ski comes to rescue you and rides you to an island full of dogs. Stay on until you land, play with the dogs (there are sunglasses in a box by the overturned boat), then follow the rescue dog into the brush: he digs up a wallet with about $1,200 next to a body.

pois.title: Easter egg 10
pois.guide: A creepy little island far out in the bay off Mariana County.
pois.revealedGuide: Take a boat into Leonida Bay to a tiny palm-tree island just north of the military air base. SOS is spelled out on the sand with a joke plea for beer next to it. Pick up the phone lying by the first S to watch the footage of what happened to the people stranded there.

pois.title: Easter egg 11
pois.guide: A nod to a street-racing film series, hidden in a garage in the Rialto Islands. Open from the start of free roam.
pois.revealedGuide: Drive to the middle of Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands, between Vice City and Vice Beach. Get into the grounds of the modern white villa (next door to the house with a luxury car out front), switch off the alarm panel by the garage and break in. Inside is a green '97 Maibatsu Penumbra FF in the film car's livery, big rear wing and all. Break open its boot and a big snake leaps out at you, a Toy Story joke. If the car isn't there, come back later.

pois.title: Easter egg: a long puzzle
pois.guide: A multi-step puzzle that starts at the radio tower in Key Lento and spans the whole map. It ends at a power plant at night. Reported by one creator so far; not yet confirmed by other guides.
pois.revealedTitle: Back to Vice City (Tommy's shirt and bike)
pois.revealedGuide: Climb the radio tower in Key Lento: upstairs, a room has posters for LPL, the power company, and one of a controller with the words "lose track of time". Flip the power switch and press the button for a classic Vice City sound. Each of the 12 LPL substations around the map has a letter on the wall plus buttons and levers; together the letters spell "Life is passing me by", the old Vice City cheat. At the substations, enter that cheat using the controls (triangle = up, circle = right, square = left, L1 = dot) in order, without fast travelling. A text then sends you to Reactor 2 at the Tortoise Head power plant between 7 PM and 6 AM. Go inside to find a portal back to 2002 Vice City; leave again to unlock Tommy Vercetti's shirt and his bike. Reported by one creator so far; not yet confirmed by other guides.

pois.title: Easter egg 12
pois.guide: A long chain of clues across Leonida's power network that ends with a trip back to an earlier Vice City. Best tried by helicopter, from chapter 3 when the whole map is open.
pois.revealedGuide: Start at the Badger R&D radio tower in Key Lento: flip the power switch and press the button until the TV reads CLUB MALIBU. Then visit the 12 LPL substations in this order and use the button or lever marked with each stop's letter (together they spell an old Vice City cheat): Downtown Vice City, Balsero, Key Lento, Penmarch Isle (Washington Beach), the northern tip of Crosstown under the highway, Port Gellhorn, Hamlet, Gloriana Key (the small building on the south-east side of the sewage treatment plant), Hamlet, just outside Gellhorn International Raceway (north-west of Whisler Motorsport), Hamlet, then North Mariana County, at the south edge of Breakwater Quarry. Fly between them, because fast travel resets your progress. A text from an unknown number then points you to Reactor 2 at the LPL Turtle Head power station east of Hamlet. Go between 7 PM and 6 AM and pull the lever beside the portal to go through: you land in a PS2-era Malibu Club and meet Kent Paul. Leaving again unlocks Tommy Vercetti's blue Hawaiian shirt and the American Glory motorbike for both Jason and Lucia.

pois.title: Easter egg 13
pois.guide: A hidden detective questline in Port Gellhorn that starts from a poster. Open from chapter 2.
pois.revealedTitle: Missing Persons (the Port Gellhorn serial killer)
pois.revealedGuide: Read the missing persons poster in the Starlet Motel reception (or the one on the wall outside the 247 store in Port Gellhorn, once the motel is gone) to get the Kelly County Tip Line contact. Break open the front shutter of the long, overgrown tin warehouse just north of Moses's garage in south Port Gellhorn and photograph the clues in the lockers in the trophy room; after that, you get in and out through a hole in its north-east corner. Then find three bodies and report each one to the tip line: in the trunk of the pink car with plate PRTYGRL in the junkyard just east of the Pay 'n' Spray, under a loose floor panel in the blue-green trailer below the rusty water tower in the abandoned trailer park west of Hank's Waffles, and in a sunken car by a dead tree in the small C-shaped pond west of town, between the airstrip and Port Gellhorn. The tip-line caller, Alvan West, is the killer. Go alone and he drugs you and you fight him in an old mine; go with both Jason and Lucia and one of them shoots him in the warehouse, which helps their relationship.

pois.title: Easter egg 14
pois.guide: A long climb up the tallest radio tower in Vice-Dale County, north of Hamlet. Bring patience: it takes several minutes.
pois.revealedGuide: Head north out of Hamlet to the tall red-and-white radio tower and climb the ladders to the top (5 to 7 minutes; sprinting helps). Grab the painted egg from the bird's nest on the right side of the top platform and throw it over the edge. A cutscene shows it splattering the windscreen of a car whose driver looks straight out of 1980s Vice City. There's no reward, so base jump or climb back down.

pois.title: Easter egg 15
pois.guide: A nod to a famous horror novel, waiting in a lift lobby in an Ocean Beach building.
pois.revealedGuide: Go into the Haymarket building in Ocean Beach and turn left from reception to the lifts. The left lift has a red balloon on it and is out of order, so call the right one: it arrives stuffed with balloons. Step in and let the doors close. The light cuts out and a clown appears for a moment before vanishing. There's no reward.

pois.title: Easter egg 16
pois.guide: A nod to a classic survival-horror series, inside a boarded-up building in Vice City. Best tried with time to explore.
pois.revealedGuide: Find the abandoned, boarded-up Marbelle Hotel with a For Sale sign on NW 8th St in south Crosstown, near the Nine1Nine club and just off the interstate. Get in through the back door and climb the stairs past mannequins facing the corners and doors that open on their own. When the door to the roof stairs swings open, the lights die, red symbols appear, whispers start and a thick fog rolls over Vice City (if the roof door stays shut, go back down and climb again). A note on the roof gives the code 955214 for a safe on the ground floor, which holds cash and a luxury watch. Opening it clears the fog and can count towards The Truth Is Out There trophy. A comic trading card sits on a cabinet opposite the stairs.

pois.title: Easter egg 17
pois.guide: A spooky tale tied to a lighthouse in Leonard County. Night-time, a boat and scuba gear needed.
pois.revealedGuide: At night, look at the top of St. Lucia Lighthouse on Little Hardin Island through binoculars (or climb up) to watch two ghosts argue until one shoves the other off. Break into the house north-west of the lighthouse and read the blue book by the fireplace. Then, in the small hours, take a boat (there's one at the house's dock) and scuba gear to the island's eastern point: the engine dies, fog rolls in and a voice speaks. Dive to the sunken boat (a metal detector helps) and take the Cursed Knife before dawn, then head back up the lighthouse to see the ghost ship.

pois.title: Easter egg 18
pois.guide: A deadly game on a remote island in Lummox County that you can only reach by water. Go alone and well prepared.
pois.revealedGuide: Take a boat to the south of Hyde Island near the Moreau River and explore it alone until a tranquilliser dart knocks you out. You wake in a shipping container without your weapons and with an explosive collar on, while a figure on a TV explains the rules. When the countdown ends, grab weapons from the lit stashes (a shotgun works well) and kill the hunter. Don't swim away or cross the fence. Afterwards, collect your gear from the boathouse on the west shore; you leave with $30,000 ($15,000 by BuckMe and $15,000 in cash). It can also start from a random event in Vice City: help a woman load a couch into a truck and you're taken to the island.

pois.title: Easter egg 19
pois.guide: A nod to a famous plumber, hidden in old ruins in Lummox County. Comes with a reward for both leads.
pois.revealedGuide: Go to the Lawton Co. Paper Mill ruins in south Moreau, just north of Mount Kalaga National Park. Find the bong on a purple tarp and take a hit: the smoke reveals a block floating overhead. Climb the ruins, stand right under it and jump into it (lining up takes a few tries) or shoot it. A jingle plays and two caps drop, one for Jason and one for Lucia.

pois.title: Easter egg 20
pois.guide: A nod to an earlier GTA, inside an ordinary-looking house in Belville. Guides don't give the exact street yet.
pois.revealedGuide: Look for a house with a white picket fence and two palm trees in the south-west residential streets of Belville. Break into its garage to find a conspiracy board, along with a trading card and a magazine to collect.

pois.title: Easter egg 21
pois.guide: A dark occult ritual in an abandoned warehouse in northern Capri. Bring a torch and something to start a fire.
pois.revealedGuide: Find the abandoned warehouse in northern Capri, just west of Top Fun Drones above Tortoise Lake (the southern building of the cluster by the lake). Inside are a blood pentagram with a body outline and a book on the altar about cleansing fire. Knock out someone nearby, such as a worker from next door, carry them in and drop them on the outline: the lights die and the candles light themselves. Take a torch upstairs to the boarded-up room for a short horror scene, then go back down, where the body rises as a demon. Burn it with a Molotov (there are some upstairs and in the pentagram room) or the gas can by the altar.

pois.title: Easter egg 22
pois.guide: Something unsettling happens if you start trouble from the top of a radio tower in Key Lento.
pois.revealedGuide: Climb the radio tower near Donnie's Caravan in southern Key Lento, take the sniper rifle at the top and shoot at people around the houses below. Sooner or later one of them stares back, draws a finger across his throat, shrugs off every bullet and comes after you, sometimes appearing right behind you. It isn't always the same person and there's no reward: just try to survive.

pois.title: Easter egg 23
pois.guide: A nod to a previous GTA hero, moored at a home in Key Lento. Open from chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Check the boat tied up at Jason's house in Key Lento and zoom in on the GPS on its dashboard: the map still shows south Los Santos and its port. There's no reward.

pois.title: Easter egg 24
pois.guide: A familiar name from a previous GTA, tucked inside a magazine at a home in Key Lento.
pois.revealedGuide: At Jason's house in Key Lento, look at the Body Copy magazine on the patio table beside the weight bench. Page 3 carries a story by the yoga guru from GTA V. There's no reward.

pois.title: Easter egg 25
pois.guide: A follow-up to another easter egg, so find that one first. The reward is a permanent boost.
pois.revealedGuide: After the UFO abduction, sleep at a safehouse as the same character to trigger a dream. In it, crouch through the egg room, use the orb to find Earth, note the code shown on the light-bar keypad (it can differ between playthroughs) and solve the milk-machine puzzle, avoiding the middle room. Then, for real, break into the fenced compound beside the big radio tower south of Hamlet, near Southpoint Airfield. Go down to the keypad door, enter your code, repeat the panel and milk puzzle and carry the alien out; the UFO deals with the soldiers. You get permanent boosts to max health, stamina and focus.

pois.title: Easter egg 26
pois.guide: A strange snack at a construction site in Lummox County leads somewhere unexpected. Any chapter, either character. The reward is a permanent boost.
pois.revealedGuide: At the construction site on the north side of Millport, at the south-east edge of Lake Tallaloko, go into the open orange shipping container and use the "???" item on the table. You're dropped into a hallucination maze: pull the lever at the first dead end and go back the other way, push through the room of hanging logs, then follow the pink-lit container hall. In the big room, climb the containers and floating objects and go through the hole lit blue, then keep jumping towards the exit sign and drop into the flooded tunnel (you can't drown). Follow it out to finish. Reward: a permanent stamina increase for that character, and the Mind Maze Left Leg Award tattoo unlocks to buy.

pois.title: Easter egg 27
pois.guide: A cartoon-style joke on a wall in Vice City's Decor District. Any time, no mission needed, and there's no reward.
pois.revealedGuide: In the Decor District, by a flyover on the road out of Vice City towards Leonard County, a wall is painted to look like a road tunnel under a bridge. From street level it looks real, but it's solid: drive into it and you crash hard, which can be fatal mid-heist. It's a nod to the Looney Tunes painted-tunnel gag. Nothing to unlock.

pois.title: Easter egg 28
pois.guide: A small nod to another Rockstar game, wandering near a mini-golf course in southern Waning Sands. Any time, no mission needed, and there's no reward.
pois.revealedGuide: By the entrance to Frontier Adventure Golf in southern Waning Sands, before the first hole, look for a chihuahua carrying a tiny Arthur Morgan figure on its back, a cowboy riding his horse. Entry is free. Nothing to unlock.

pois.title: Easter egg 38
pois.guide: A late-night invitation in northern Port Gellhorn leads to something unexpected. From chapter 2, either character. The rewards include a permanent boost.
pois.revealedGuide: Around midnight, find the Circles of Hell house with its garage open in northern Port Gellhorn. Chat with the two metalheads there, answering "Having fun?" and then "It's good", and get into their van. At the campsite, stare into the fire to be pulled into a fight with Satan. Win it for a Circles of Hell top, a tattoo, the Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun next to his throne, and a permanent health increase. Works from chapter 2 as Jason or Lucia.

pois.title: Easter egg 39
pois.guide: A nod to a famous cartoon crew, hidden in a storm drain just north of Millport. Any time, no mission needed, and there's no reward.
pois.revealedGuide: Just north of Millport, towards the Lake Tallaloko dam, take the stairs down to the storm drain outfall where green slime oozes down the wall. At the end of the drain are four turtles with pizza boxes, a nod to the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Easiest to spot at night. The slime is also the Intriguing Substance WAiNK scan. Nothing to unlock.

pois.title: Easter egg 29
pois.guide: A nod to a Stephen King novel, waiting in a garage in North Leonard County.
pois.revealedGuide: North Leonard County: open the small garage opposite the farmhouse. Inside is the Albany Driveshaft Devanity, a red-eyed 1950s classic modelled on Christine (plate P05 ESD). You can drive it away.

pois.title: Easter egg 30
pois.guide: A nod to a classic gangster film, at a motel in Ocean Beach. Go around midday.
pois.revealedGuide: Ocean Beach: go to the Sunlite Motel on Shore Dr, at the south end of Ocean Beach, between 12 PM and 1 PM. Go upstairs and try the first room's door, walk along the balcony, go downstairs and back round to the front to watch the scene play out. Then go back up to the bloodied room and pick up the Little Friend W-10 SMG from the floor.

pois.title: Easter egg 31
pois.guide: Something huge on the seabed off the Leonida Keys. Bring a boat and scuba gear.
pois.revealedGuide: Leonida Keys: take a boat with scuba gear from the Gloriana Key docks into the deep water south-east of Gloriana Key and dive to the shipwreck on the seabed. A giant kraken has its tentacles wrapped around it. It doesn't move or attack, there's no map marker and no reward. Watch for sharks.

pois.title: Easter egg 32
pois.guide: A nod to a superhero film at the end of a strange farm questline in Kelly County. Chapter 3.
pois.revealedGuide: Kelly County: Kyle's questline starts from the Pilot Wanted flyer outside the Starlet Motel reception (chapter 2). His final mission, Buddy? (Check on Kyle), unlocks in chapter 3: go to McKittrick Farm in Frogswater, north-east of the Starlet Motel, and investigate his disappearance. Kill the Red Hulk for $5,000, or spare him and you can hug him (it hurts, so have enough health).

pois.title: Easter egg 33
pois.guide: A cartoon home by a roadside near Bluegrass.
pois.revealedGuide: Bluegrass: by the bus stop sign on Cicada Ave, a big yellow pineapple with a round window and a bench inside serves as the bus shelter. You can walk in. There's no reward.

pois.title: Easter egg 34
pois.guide: A strange influencer on a remote beach in the Leonida Keys. Reach it by boat.
pois.revealedGuide: Shoeless Keys: take a boat or jet ski north-west of Key Lento to a small, isolated beach. A man in a sparkly mermaid tail is filming himself; he asks you to spray water on his tail. Knock over his tripod or step into shot and he turns on you. There's no reward.

pois.title: Easter egg 35
pois.guide: A nod to a horror novel, hidden in the woods in Lummox County.
pois.revealedGuide: Grayson: in the woods beside SR-73 in southern Grayson, follow the strange animal noises to a hidden pet cemetery. Scanning the graves also counts as the Pet Cemetery WAiNK curiosity.

pois.title: Easter egg 36
pois.guide: A nod to an old GTA mountain mystery, north of Port Gellhorn.
pois.revealedGuide: Manifest Canyon: north of Port Gellhorn, west of SR-73, a 1982 monument with four horse statues (wildlife, corruption, humanity and yeyo) is the game's Mount Chiliad-style mystery. It's also a WAiNK sculpture.

pois.title: Easter egg 37
pois.guide: Something out of this world at the top of Leonida's tallest peak.
pois.revealedGuide: Kalaga National Park: climb to the summit of Mount Kalaga to find a meteorite surrounded by Stonehenge-style standing stones.

pois.title: Loophole Architecture
pois.guide: Rockridge: take the lift in the Parlor Apartments lobby up to the roof and photograph the round structure on the west side.

pois.title: Compliance Theater
pois.guide: Downtown: get onto the Compliance Theater roof (land a helicopter or take the lift, avoiding security), climb the southern antenna and photograph the roof below.

pois.title: Extraction Service
pois.guide: Downtown: take the lobby lift to the Extraction Service roof, go to the north-west corner and photograph the roof to the west.

pois.title: Privatized Pains Socialized Gains
pois.guide: Ocean Beach, Vice Beach: stand on the pavement just north-west of Effluvia Bar and photograph the painting on the underside of the car park to the south-east.

pois.title: You Signed the Terms & Conditions
pois.guide: Crosstown: from the pavement just south of the Mule City Line subway stop, photograph the painted train. It only counts while the train is stopped at the station.

pois.title: Dalton Island Statue
pois.guide: Dalton Island: the stunt jump at the Dalton Island Sculpture Park, under the big star-shaped canopy. Use one of AudaCity's vehicles.

pois.title: Mastodon Sand Mill
pois.guide: Stockyard: the stunt jump at the Mastodon sand mill, beside the freeway. Use one of AudaCity's vehicles.

pois.title: St. Vitus Medical Center
pois.guide: Penmarch Isle, Washington Beach: the stunt jump by St. Vitus Medical Center, just off the bridge. Use one of AudaCity's vehicles.

pois.title: Leonida Power and Light
pois.guide: Tequesta: the stunt jump at the Leonida Power and Light site. The map circle is approximate. Use one of AudaCity's vehicles.

pois.title: Vice City Parking Department (Ocean Beach)
pois.guide: Ocean Beach: the stunt jump on the Vice City Parking Department Ocean Beach garage, a few blocks in from the beach. Use one of AudaCity's vehicles.

pois.title: Meet at the Vice City Sign
pois.guide: Unlocks once the first five stunts are done. Meet an AudaCity engineer at the giant Vice City sign in West Vice-Dale County, by Three Toe Lake west of VCIA. It's a run of stunt jumps one after another, finishing with a jump over the Vice City sign.

pois.title: Meet at the Piker Financial Center
pois.guide: Unlocks once the first five stunts are done. Meet an AudaCity engineer on the roof of the Piker Financial Center in Downtown Vice City, just south of the big freeway interchange by the river. It's a parachute jump: leap off, fly through the gap between a pair of buildings and land on the ground below. The map circle is approximate.

pois.title: Plane stunt at Avery Allen airfield
pois.guide: Starts at Avery Allen & Co. Aviation Services, Pilot Pete's airfield in North Kelly County. Fly the plane with Papa Audacity riding on its roof: under bridges and through barrel rolls over the rich neighbourhoods, then bail out and land on a boat.

_note: Confirmed content only. v7: the six named regions and the eleven activities (Game Informer, 29 Sep 2026, plus Wyman's Classic Car Collection). v8: the 55-trophy list (Xbox achievement data via Exophase, and Press Start's PS5 list, 18 Nov 2026); every new item is marked spoiler, and story and secret trophies have neutral titles. v9: the real names and how-tos behind the 27 neutral trophies, in revealedTitle/revealedGuide (shown by spoiler-shield builds once done or revealed). v10: 91 story missions (PowerPyx walkthrough, PC Gamer, Press Start), 39 Strangers & Freaks (PowerPyx), and the game's own 100% checklist as 34 items with the 100% thresholds (PowerPyx); the Path to 100% now follows that checklist, and the 11 activities moved to 100%+. Card sets, meditation, playlists, video games, pool, mini golf and shooting ranges are listed one by one (PowerPyx). Bank jobs, payday loans, Smash 'N' Grabs, race challenges and the 80 challenges are listed one by one too (PowerPyx). v11: card sets, meditation and playlists are marked collectible, for Progress's Collectibles card. Also v11: lists PowerPyx is still filling in (flamingos, magazines, book swaps, WAiNK, stunt jumps, unique races, gang operations, drug labs) are listed item by item with what's known so far, alongside the 100% counter rows; more items get added as the lists grow. Animals: the game's 8 animal groups as counters (255 in all, PowerPyx), until a species list exists. From Danny's own in-game Progress captures (18 Nov): 50 animal species, and Kenton's 6 wrecks with 12 named treasures (descriptions in our own words). v12: Danny's post-v11 refinements (sub-categories, animal stats and pictures, challenges' own category id) under a new version, so apps that already applied v11 pick them up. v12 also links trophies to the lists they count: races, card sets, challenges, vaults, WAiNK, stunt jumps, Strangers & Freaks strands and video games. v13: more entries from other guide sites, each confirmed by two of them: 14 flamingos, 2 magazines, 4 WAiNK scans (game menu numbers not known yet, so their ids use names), and the 42 Top Fun drone time trials at 14 locations. v31: fuller trophy descriptions in revealedGuide (PowerPyx trophy guide), a Garages list (12: 8 for sale and 4 from the story, prices from PowerPyx and StealthyGaming, pins placed by eye from PowerPyx's map screenshots) and a Master of None list (the 9 activity types, PowerPyx), all spoiler; trophies linked so they track themselves: bank vaults (bank jobs list now complete), stunts, Top Fun, vehicles, garages and activity types.
